title: MailboxRelayAuthority::lock holds StateInner across the whole relay operation (13.8 s hold at mailbox_relay_rpc.rs:26)
outcome: A native mailbox relay operation checks its authority under StateInner but does not keep StateInner held for the operation's own store work, so a slow relay commit cannot block the host's state lock for seconds.
acceptance: A channel-gated real-store regression proves unrelated StateInner access during an admitted relay transaction, with durable exactly-once and retry assertions.

Native relay authorization and new-only participation are validated on one short StateInner cut; StateInner is released before the operation's own store commit; the existing link fence remains; pre-admission stale root, transport or config refuses; and the agreed in-flight admission semantics are tested.
Relevant relay, storage and authority focused checks, and an independent Codex+Claude pair with no in-scope Medium+, then exact integration FULL and landing evidence.
